name: Foundation
requirement: Oneness System installed and `prime doctor` returns ready

boss.name: The Saboteur of Incompletion
boss.pattern: leaving admin installers unrun, not restarting Codex, not filling .env
boss.defeat_action: Run Oneness Admin Install as admin; restart Codex; fill .env keys
boss.reward: Windows service live; node_repl/Chrome control enabled; APIs authenticated

name: Automation
requirement: Aura subagents running and adapting to your sessions

boss.name: The Distraction Hydra
boss.pattern: many apps competing for RAM/CPU while gaming or working
boss.defeat_action: Run `prime aura start`; let GameGuard pause cleaners during CoD; trim only when idle
boss.reward: Gaming-aware optimization; background finance scans continue quietly

name: Capital
requirement: Live Polymarket data flowing and compound math validated

boss.name: The Risk Phantom
boss.pattern: trading without size limits, EV checks, or Kelly sizing
boss.defeat_action: Set max order/exposure in config/agents.yaml; run `prime finance markets` daily; size via Kelly/EV
boss.reward: Evidence-based prediction-market edge with bounded downside

name: Sovereignty
requirement: System self-heals, backs up memory, and survives reboots

boss.name: The Decay Warden
boss.pattern: logs pile up, configs drift, services fail silently over time
boss.defeat_action: Confirm scheduled tasks `Oneness-*`; add cloud backup of memory/; run `prime fix` weekly
boss.reward: 24/7 durable organism that compounds data, capital, and capability

name: Ascension
requirement: Human-AI council operates with delegated authority and audit trail

boss.name: The Ego Sovereign
boss.pattern: refusing to delegate; micromanaging; ignoring the council
boss.defeat_action: Let SYNAPSE dispatch; review daily brief; approve or veto, never stall
boss.reward: Maximum leverage: time, capital, intelligence, and freedom compound together
